Cognate with {{cog|stq|skar}}, {{m|stq|sker||a share in a communal pasture}}, {{cog|nl|schare||share in property}}, {{cog|de|Schar||band, troop, party, company}}, {{cog|is|skor||department}}. {{ux|en|Each of the robbers took a '''share''' of the loot.}} #: {{ux|en|The [[TV programme]] was cancelled because it only gained a 10% '''share''' of that night's [[viewing audience]].}} #
